# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2019

**Ordinance No. 03**

An Ordinance Ratifying the Loan Agreement, Assignment and Other Supporting Documents Pertaining to the Loan/Credit Facility Entered Into By and Between the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]] Represented by Honorable Mayor [[Paulino S. Sayat]] and [[Land Bank of the Philippines]] Through Its Quezon Lending Center Head, Mr. [[Joel S. Babaan]] in the Amount of Fifteen Million Pesos (P15,000,000.00) for the Purpose of Financing the Acquisition of Brand New Heavy Equipment.

## Summary

Enacted on March 18, 2019 during the old term, this ordinance ratifies the loan agreement and supporting documents for a P15,000,000.00 credit facility between the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] and the [[Land Bank of the Philippines]]. The loan was arranged through the bank's Quezon Lending Center, headed by [[Joel S. Babaan]], and is intended to finance the acquisition of brand new heavy equipment for municipal use. The borrowing was previously authorized under MO No. 01 of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]], enacted on February 18, 2019. The ordinance was enacted under the old-term composition with Mayor [[Paulino S. Sayat]] and Vice Mayor [[Dexter L. Sayat]] presiding.

## Key Provisions

- **Ratification of Loan Agreement.** Ratifies the loan agreement, assignment, and all supporting documents pertaining to the P15,000,000.00 credit facility with [[Land Bank of the Philippines]].
- **Purpose.** The loan proceeds shall be used exclusively for the acquisition of brand new heavy equipment for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]].
- **Authorization Reference.** References MO No. 01 of the SB, enacted February 18, 2019, which initially authorized the borrowing.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
